image: In manifests/*.json, relative to the containing manifest. In the original source records at the package root, relative to the package root. All paths resolve inside this package.
artifact_id: Active catalog identity, or null for unknown control.
sha256: Normalized file checksum, bound to review decision.
original_sha256: Downloaded source byte checksum, when available.
pixel_sha256: SHA256 of decoded RGB size and pixels.
capture_group: Conservative shared capture/source group; cannot cross splits.
source_split: For train rows, preserves the original reference assignment from the shared source dataset.
assignment_note: Explains the Week 1 training assignment; it does not imply that model training has taken place.
evaluation_use: All validation/test rows are previously exposed pilot data.
dhash: 64-bit grayscale difference hash; heuristic similarity only.
license: Per-source license; retain attribution and source terms.
